units.source_text: 晚夏宁静的日光，在究竟顶的屋顶上贴上了金箔，倾泻直下的光，使金阁内部充满了夜一般的黑暗。

en.t: The quiet sunlight of late summer gilded the roof of the Ultimate Summit, and the light pouring straight down filled the inside of the Golden Pavilion with a darkness like night.

units.source_text: 过去，这建筑物的不朽的时间压迫着我，阻隔着我。

en.t: In the past, the immortal time embodied by this building had oppressed me and kept me apart from it.

units.source_text: 可是，想到不久它将被燃烧弹的火烧却的命运，也就与我们的命运靠近过来了。

en.t: But when I thought of its fate, soon to be burned down by incendiary bombs, it came closer to our own fate as well.

units.source_text: 也许金阁会先于我们而毁灭。

en.t: Perhaps the Golden Pavilion would be destroyed before we were.

units.source_text: 这样一来，我觉得金阁和我们仿佛经历着同样的生。

en.t: In that case, I felt that the Golden Pavilion and we were somehow living through the same life.
